body_html:
@asymmetricinfo Can we have a discussion saying, But by the time The Post approached me, I’d already concluded that the battle for the open Internet was lost." (unless referring to Net Nuetrality..tend to agree mroe.. but not as much).

The open Internet is so much more than just #OpenJournalism and further I believe paywalls can help #OpenJournalism thrive (ignoring those who argue open must be free).
